# PR 003 — Distinguish output anti-collapse from gradient access

> Reconstructed on 2026-10-11. Historical evidence window: 2026-10-04 18:52–18:59 UTC.

**Branch:** `research/exp-03-gradient-recoverability`  
**Base:** `main`  
**Tag:** `v0.3.0`

## Hypothesis

Temperature, probability floors, clipping, or residual routing will restore adaptation if router collapse is primarily an output-saturation problem.

## Result

The epsilon floor removed measured saturation but reached only 0.5444 ± 0.0878. Logit clipping peaked at 0.5877 ± 0.1074.

## Review decision

Merge the falsification. Nonzero mass is not sufficient; create a fast distribution whose derivative does not traverse the saturated slow softmax.
